camera.source: Current live DVR Camera 3 RTSP, existing VLC/OpenCV pipeline; production preview JPEG used as calibration reference
camera.reference_note: Fresh daylight reference; old nighttime image and generic geometry not used. Embedded DVR clock differs from host clock; neither is substituted for the other.

road_roi.reason: Conservative interior of visibly identifiable asphalt, excluding upper parking forecourt, left frontage, right building/steps, and near cropped foreground. Not a survey of lanes or entire road width.

stopped_vehicle.reason: Inset roadway section where a vehicle obstructing travel is relevant; contained by road polygon and excludes off-road parking. Existing require_prior_motion=true remains mandatory. Geometry enabled; incident sequence not demonstrated.

wrong_way.reason: Disabled: road geometry and observed motion do not establish a unique legally permitted direction. No direction vector or real-camera incident generated.

congestion.reason: Clearly identifiable conservative road polygon enables existing congestion rule only; no thresholds changed. Positive congestion-event behavior remains unvalidated.

detection.scope: Visible cars detected, not exhaustive recall validation
detection.limitation: Large silver foreground vehicle visibly present without a published detection box in these frames. This task does not identify whether absence originates in detector, tracker or filtering. Do not treat NORMAL as proof of an unobstructed road.

tracking.scope: Live production IDs across successive observations
evidence: frame-6186.jpg -> frame-6192.jpg: IDs 386 and 377 persist while their positions change. Parked IDs 163 and 3 remain visible.
tracking.limitation: Not a long-duration identity-switch or recall evaluation.

ROI.scope: Visual geometry plus real production inclusion/exclusion
evidence: frame-5466.jpg: two parked tracked cars outside polygon, production ROI count 0.
frame-5885.jpg: four detected cars, production ROI count 1, density 0.184; interior car #359 included; off-road parked detections excluded.
frame-6186.jpg: five detected cars, production ROI count 2, density 0.345.
ROI.limitation: Only conservative central roadway monitored. Production uses detection/track centers; a vehicle partially intersecting the polygon can be excluded if its center lies outside. No claim of full-lane coverage.

stopped_vehicle.reason: No documented naturally observed tracked MOVES -> in stopped ROI -> stationary for configured 8 seconds -> ONE proposed event sequence. Foreground vehicle already present in this observation cannot be used as a positive stopped test. No fake live event created.

wrong_way.reason: Disabled: road geometry and observed motion do not establish a unique legally permitted direction. No direction vector or real-camera incident generated.

congestion.reason: Calibrated road enables existing metric/rule computation. Selected frames show NORMAL and ROI counts 0/1/2. No sustained congestion scenario observed; thresholds were not tuned or validated for event sensitivity. NORMAL is detector-derived, not guaranteed physical traffic truth.

observation.method: Read-only sampling of actual production annotated JPEGs, metrics and health every 0.5 seconds; no replay, second model or synthetic incident
observation.synchronization_limit: JPEG and JSON files read sequentially and can differ by one publication. Exact frame-specific ROI counts and IDs cited above come from the same annotated image, not a join to neighboring JSON.

activation.operator_authorization: Keep enabled, document manual night disable (explicit user reply).
activation.manual_night_disable: Set camera_calibrations.camera-3.road_confirmed=false and stopped_confirmed=false in ai/config/live_camera.json, then restart only Camera 3 worker. This disables road-dependent rules and returns traffic to UNKNOWN. Do this before nighttime operation. Restore flags only after confirming daylight and unchanged camera position/resolution.
activation.overall_status_explanation: CALIBRATION_REQUIRED is expected because Wrong Way remains intentionally uncalibrated; road/stopped/congestion individually READY.

safety.tests: 218 AI tests passed in 18.20 seconds; git diff --check passed. Updated actual Camera 3 profile integration assertion and tested ROI inclusion/exclusion with synthetic observations; synthetic test is not claimed as real-camera validation. Existing stopped prior-motion regression tests passed.
safety.temporary_instrumentation: No production instrumentation added or diagnostic capture enabled. Temporary read-only observer/overlay/report scripts ran outside repository and were removed after report generation.

next_action: During daylight observe and preserve one naturally occurring detected/tracked moving-to-stopped sequence in the stopped ROI. Investigate the foreground vehicle missing from published detections separately before relying on stopped/congestion alerts.
